## About
Motor-Head is still owned and operated by Frank Resuriz, the first generation owner, and we are still in our original location in Stafford. Our machinists handle diesel motors, valve jobs, head pressure tests, flywheel resurfacing and complete engine rebuilds.
Head rebuilding is our specialty, and we also do general automotive repair. We have worked on vehicles for car dealerships, emergency vehicles and fleets, along with plenty of folks bringing in their own truck or project car.
Customers tell us they appreciate that Frank is straight with them about what a job needs and what it will cost. We are rated 4.1 on Google from 60 reviews.

## Services
- Head rebuilds: Head rebuilding is the core of what we do, from complete head rebuilds to the detail work around them.
- Complete engine rebuilds: Full engine rebuilds for trucks, project cars and everyday drivers.
- Valve jobs and head pressure tests: Valve work and pressure testing of heads by our machinists.
- Flywheel resurfacing: Resurfacing worn flywheels so they are ready to go back in.
- Crack checks: Checking an engine for cracks before the machine work starts.
- General automotive repair: Along with machine work, we handle general repair.

## FAQ
Q: Who runs the shop?
A: Motor-Head is still owned and operated by Frank Resuriz, the first generation owner.

Q: Do you work on diesel engines?
A: Yes. Our machinists specialize in diesel motors along with valve jobs, head pressure tests and flywheel resurfacing.

Q: Do you have a price list?
A: A price sheet is in the works. For now, give us a call and we will talk through your job.

Q: How do I reach you?
A: Call us at 281-499-5131, send a fax to 281-499-5547, or email frank@motor-head.com.
